signals.headline: EU Accessibility Act in force since June 2025; WCAG 2.1 AA now global de-facto standard
signals.summary: European Accessibility Act (EAA) became law across all EU member states on June 28, 2025, applying to any organization providing products/services to EU consumers. EAA requires WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for all digital properties. Non-compliance penalties range from written warnings to substantial fines. WCAG 2.1 AA has solidified as the de-facto legal standard for private business digital properties globally.
signals.gradial_commentary: For Gradial's global enterprise customers, EAA + WCAG 2.1 AA compliance is now a hard requirement, not a 'nice to have.' This regulatory shift creates a forcing function for enterprises to implement automated accessibility validation across their content supply chains. Gradial's positioning should frame accessibility agents as compliance infrastructure — required by law, automatically validated by agents, embedded into every page build workflow.
signals.sentiment_reason: Mandatory compliance deadline (June 2025 already passed) + global adoption of WCAG 2.1 AA standard creates urgent buyer urgency for Gradial's accessibility automation.
